approvalTitle: tasks.md: converting the SPARQL query diagram (written against the recommended amendment)
content:
# Tasks Document

One Developer owns this specification, per CLAUDE.md's one-owner-per-specification rule, and works it in one worktree (`.claude/worktrees/spq`, branch `features/sparql-disl-fbl`). **The order is the design's eight steps and it is load-bearing**: the transcript is frozen before anything changes (task 1), the parser gains its spans before anything reads them (task 3), the library computes what the definition states before the definition is bundled (tasks 4 to 6), and derivation is switched before reading (tasks 7 and 8 before task 9), so that a difference in the transcript can be attributed to one change. Three design steps are two tasks each because one pull request would not be reviewable alone: step 4 is tasks 4, 5 and 6, and step 5 is tasks 7 and 8.

**Every task is one pull request into `develop` and leaves the four gates green.** No open question changes behaviour at its default, so a task whose transcript differs at all is not delivered.

**Task 2 is done in etalii-adp/etalii.adp**, through that repository's own pull request, and task 11 raises a second pull request there for the companion's closing table.

**What waits, and on what.**

- **Tasks 4 and 5 wait on task 2 being merged in etalii.adp**, because each begins by loading the rewritten definition to confirm its list of missing library items. Each also begins with a search of the library on `develop`: derived node types, derived relations with `key` and `owner`, and budgets are needed by several tools of the series, and another specification may have delivered one first. What is already there is not built again.
- **Task 6 waits on task 2 merged and on tasks 4 and 5**, because the bundled definition must load with no error.
- **Tasks 7 and 8 wait on tasks 3 and 6; task 9 waits on task 8; task 10 waits on task 6 only** and may be worked before tasks 7 to 9.
- **Task 3 waits on task 1 only** and can be done while task 2 is in review.
- **No task waits on a language change.** The seven gaps of the requirements' section C and the eighth of `SparqlChrome` are reproduced as today's behaviour and recorded (task 11); the three changes of Q3 and the four defects of Q4 are reproduced with their fixtures and raised afterwards, outside this specification. A binding's `args` for a plugin waits on a second tool that needs it and is not built here.

**This document is written against the recommended option of each amendment the design proposes; a ruling that differs is a small amendment to the tasks named.** The design proposes one: Requirement 9.2 reads that the design lists the library items from a reading and a load of the rewritten definition at the start of the library step confirms the list. It touches tasks 4 and 5, whose first action is that load.

---

## The coverage diff, run before this document was raised

**53 acceptance criteria in the requirements; 53 claimed by the tasks below; none unclaimed, nothing claimed that is not a criterion, and none claimed twice.**

| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 5 | 1 (1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.4), 7 (1.5) |
| 2 | 5 | 2 (2.1, 2.2, 2.3), 6 (2.4, 2.5) |
| 3 | 6 | 3 (3.3), 9 (3.1, 3.2, 3.4, 3.5, 3.6) |
| 4 | 5 | 7 (4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5), 9 (4.1) |
| 5 | 6 | 8 (5.1 to 5.6) |
| 6 | 5 | 9 (6.1 to 6.5) |
| 7 | 3 | 7 (7.1), 9 (7.2, 7.3) |
| 8 | 3 | 8 (8.2), 11 (8.1, 8.3) |
| 9 | 4 | 4 (9.1), 5 (9.2, 9.3), 11 (9.4) |
| 10 | 3 | 10 (10.1, 10.2, 10.3) |
| 11 | 4 | 2 (11.2), 11 (11.1, 11.3, 11.4) |
| 12 | 4 | 6 (12.3), 11 (12.1, 12.2, 12.4) |

Four claims are worth a sentence, because a criterion is claimed once and the work behind it is not always in one task.

- **3.3 is claimed by task 3**, where the span and the line of every entry are made. `SparqlRecords` (task 7) and the plugin's `Read` (task 9) hand them on unchanged, and the span test of task 9 is the evidence the second diff traces 3.3 to.
- **3.1 is claimed by task 9**, which embeds the module's binding. Its second sentence, the example binding in etalii.adp, is written in task 2.
- **4.1 is claimed by task 9**, because the model is built from the plugin's reading only there. Task 7 already builds it with `DislModelBuilder`, from the same records.
- **12.1 is claimed by task 11**, which checks every page and remark. Each is edited in the task that makes its sentence false (tasks 6 and 9), as the criterion says.

**The diff is run again at task 11**, traced to the tests, files and strings the work produced and not to a task's promise, and two traces are read back to their artefacts to check that the evidence is that criterion's and not a neighbour's.

---
